description: This file generates the detail view page for a module in the vtiger CRM system, retrieving entity info, permissions, related lists, and custom links, then rendering the 'DetailView.tpl' template.

classes.name: $focus
classes.description: An instance of the current module's class, representing the entity being viewed.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine instance used for rendering the view.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for the given record and module.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Fetches the display name(s) for the entity.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for the record.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into arrays for fields, types, and labels.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for actions like EditView and Delete.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related lists for the current module and record.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves block information for the detail view.
